name: Space Doubt
source:
Ever wonder what could happen out in space? 
No? Well this game doesn't really answer that question.

When  your spaceship goes down, it's up to you to decide whether to choose  to trust or doubt your decisions. Who knows, you may have to encounter something a bit... unexpected...

[From [url=https://wevdrazoon.itch.io/space-doubt]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
有没有想过太空中会发生什么？
不？好吧，这个游戏并没有真正回答这个问题。

当你的宇宙飞船坠毁时，你可以决定是选择相信还是怀疑你的决定。谁知道，你可能会遇到一些……意想不到的事情……

[来自[url=https://wevdrazoon.itch.io/space-doubt]Itch.io[/url]]
